operative_text: Section 4 (s. 394.463(2)(d)3., F.S.): The process for the actual return of firearms or ammunition seized or voluntarily surrendered under this paragraph may not take longer than 7 days, unless a behavioral health professional who has conducted a current mental health assessment of the person certifies that there is substantial likelihood that in the near future, the person will inflict serious bodily harm on self or others, as evidenced by recent behavior causing, attempting, or threatening such harm.
